# aoss_vlan (Resource)

Manages a VLAN and its member ports and trunk circuits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aoss_vlan" "lan" {
  vlan_id  = 10
  name     = "LAN"
  untagged = [for i in range(1, 24) : tostring(i)]
  tagged   = ["24", "25", "26", "27", "28", "Trk1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vlan_id` (Number) The VLAN identifier.

### Optional

- `dhcp` (Boolean) Whether the VLAN interface obtains its IP address via DHCP. The switch records the setting as "ip address dhcp".
- `name` (String) The VLAN name, as shown in the running configuration.
- `tagged` (Set of String) The tagged members of the VLAN: port numbers and/or trunk circuit names of the form Trk<N>.
- `untagged` (Set of String) The untagged members of the VLAN: port numbers and/or trunk circuit names of the form Trk<N>.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
